title: RPG Maker MZ - Particle System Plugin - TRP Particle MZ

posts.author: kimz115
posts.body: How do you use this on Steam DLC plugins? Can someone guide me on this? Thank you! Im done purchase it.

posts.author: MiguelRPG
posts.body:
I don't know if I understood very well, but here are some possible tips:
1. Find the plugin:
After purchasing the particle DLC, go to the DLC folder in RPG Maker.
Go to the Steam library, right-click on RPG Maker Mz and browse the local files.
In the folder that opens, go to DLCs and the plugin will be there.
2. I have a project and I want to use the plugin:
Inside this DLC there is the file manual_en.pdf that teaches you how to install the plugin in your project.
Basically, you will copy the files from the plugin folder to the plugin folder of your project and copy the commands from the example project to your project.
